entities.summary: Hyung Jin Moon, also known as Sean Moon, is an American minister, who along with his wife Yeon Ah Lee Moon founded the Pennsylvania-based World Peace and Unification Sanctuary Church. The Sanctuary Church is a schismatic sect, which was founded by Hyung Jin Moon. and is independent from Unification Church.
